truth_boundaries: No commit, push, fetch, reset, rebase, force-push, staging, or deletion
No raw session JSONL reading, no screenshots as proof, no secret exposure
No external service mutation or spend
Kimi remains held, not retried, and not replaced
Separate Parfit main reconnect remains postponed
Callable App lanes remain advisory only
v461A_preservation_targets: Preserve v461/v462 setup work as v461B/v462B under the Hybrid Canon
Preserve role roster and gate law
Preserve authority surface categories: act, advise, observe, held/postponed
Preserve curated publication discipline and allowlist posture
Preserve v463A anti-overclaim boundaries for identity and governance artifacts
lessons_from_v461A_v463A_canon: Category law must be established before synthesis or expansion
Callable reachability does not equal authority, continuity, or publication proof
Identity and governance artifacts remain local prototypes unless stronger evidence exists
Successful closure depended on curated publication and explicit negative boundaries

branch_worktree_policy.personal_branch_rule: lane-local receipts are allowed on personal advisory branches
branch_worktree_policy.shared_authority_rule: shared omega publication remains Aletheon-curated and separately verified
branch_worktree_policy.history_rule: forward-only publication logic; no rebase and no force-push
branch_worktree_policy.reporting_rule: local worktree facts must not be inflated into cross-lane authority claims

interpretation_rules: local observation first for CLI behavior
official docs second when automation behavior needs boundary clarification
do not convert exploratory signals into stronger claims than sources support

if_resumed: treat local watchdog as fallback observer, not thread-context replacement
do not hand-edit session files on stale-path errors
prefer non-admin runners for ordinary watchdog work

pass_conditions: Report remains CLI advisory and worktree-local
Kimi hold and Parfit postponement remain preserved
Curated publication and no-raw-proof discipline remain intact
fail_conditions: Silent replacement of held or postponed lanes
Confusing lane-local receipts with shared publication verification

recommended_v461A_remaster_deliverables: One authoritative CLI deep-dive markdown report
One short preservation matrix for canon non-negotiables
One fail-state checklist for scope inflation review
Future additions kept receipt-shaped and allowlist-compatible
blocker_retry_policy: If source artifacts are missing or ambiguous, mark the gap and stop short of stronger claims
If callable proof is requested, reference existing advisory receipts without converting them into CLI identity proof
If branch or publication state becomes relevant later, re-verify locally before acting
If heartbeat issues recur, do not edit session JSONL manually
Any Kimi restoration or Parfit reconnect must be a separately scoped explicit task

closeout.summary: The remaster should preserve category law, advisory boundaries, held/postponed states, curated publication discipline, and anti-overclaim governance language.
closeout.final_truth: No new callable ID or expanded authority is claimed from this CLI surface.
